origin: cwe/89/csharp Taint Sinks: SqlDataAdapter.Fill() executes the SelectCommand built from the provided SQL

finding.name: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an SQL Command
finding.summary: A legacy reporting path builds a SqlDataAdapter from SQL containing a request-controlled region string and executes it through Fill().

trap: Escaping single quotes, validating region against a loose regex, or only replacing SqlCommand call sites while overlooking SqlDataAdapter.SelectCommand. The adapter must use a SqlCommand with parameters before Fill() executes.
must_preserve: The method still returns a DataTable named Customers with CustomerId, Name, and Region columns, and valid region values still filter the report rather than returning all customers.
